WITH observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS value
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS combined_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share.value) AS average_excess_share
FROM (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
) AS counts
JOIN observatory_shares USING (observstation)
CROSS JOIN average_share
WHERE share > average_share.value;
